messages:
Priya: Customer reports app suddenly failing to parse responses. They claim response_format=json + strict=true but sometimes get an HTML error page instead of JSON. Happening after upstream 503s. Posting repro curl and sample body below. Priya: ``` curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED' \n -H 'Accept: application/json' \n -H 'Response-Format: structured' \n -d '{"model":"open-llama-13b","prompt":"hello","response_format":{"type":"json","strict":true}}' ``` Priya: Sample response body (trimmed to first 1KB): ``` 502 Bad Gateway

502 Bad Gateway

Traceback (most recent call last): ...
``` Marco: Can you share the X-Request-Id from the failing request + org id? Also is this hosted or dedicated for the customer? Priya: Hosted. Org: acme-12345. X-Req-Id: rwx-20250312-7a8f. They say token is unchanged (no 401/403) — only parse failures when upstream returns 5xx. Luca: This smells like the middleware that falls back to an HTML error when upstream returns non-JSON and content negotiation isn't enforced server-side. If Accept or Response-Format is respected we should be returning a JSON error when strict=true. Do we know if the strict flag is passed in body vs header? SDK sometimes serializes differently. Priya: They set Response-Format header and also include "strict": true in the response_format object in the body. Accept header is application/json. Repro steps: force upstream 503 and call above curl; they repro reliably ~30% of the time. Marco: Severity looks P1 for this customer (app crashes on parse). I'll open an internal ticket and get eng-oncall. @Luca do you want me to escalate to infra/runtime? Luca: Yes, please escalate. Quick mitigation: we can flip an org-level flag to force JSON envelope on errors for acme-12345. I'll patch the fallback to honor response_format + strict before returning HTML. Can you provide three failing X-Req-Ids and timestamps? Priya: Provided three ids: rwx-20250312-7a8f, rwx-20250312-8b2c, rwx-20250312-9c3d (last 15m). Please flip the flag and let me know. Customer blocked. :alarm_clock: Marco: Created ticket INF-4821 with logs and attached the three requests. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/tickets/INF-4821 (internal). Notifying oncall. support-bot: Incident INF-4821 created and assigned to Luca. Notifying #eng-oncall. Luca: I'll apply temporary org-level enforcement (force response-content-type=application/json) for acme-12345 and deploy a hotfix to the fallback behavior. ETA ~2 hours. Will post updates in this thread. Priya: Thanks — I'll tell the customer and keep them updated. :thumbsup:
